d:Hearth.VenueTypeDef/HH_Venue_Tavern.mo: Drinks on a shelf stay tidy and are easy to restock.
Six seats or more, so a group can come in together.
Good light makes a room feel welcoming after dark.
d:MentalStateDef/HH_GamblingSpree.recove: {0} has come down from the gambling spree.
d:PreceptDef/HH_Indulgences_Sacred.comps: No indulgence bought for a quadrum
d:Silverline.AssetDef/SL_Asset_GrowthFun: Our managers beat the market (we did not say which market).
d:Silverline.AssetDef/SL_Asset_MemeBooma: Volatile by design, flammable by nature.
d:Silverline.AssetDef/SL_Asset_MemeThrum: To the moon, on foot, slowly.
d:Silverline.AssetDef/SL_Asset_NftMuffal: You own the idea of the picture.
d:Silverline.AssetDef/SL_Asset_RimCoin.t: Trust the maths. Not the exchange.
d:Silverline.SL_BankDef/SL_BlackLedger.p: Loans ignore your credit score (and your feelings).
Every quadrum there is a 1 % risk that a quarter of the balance is "seized".
Only open to colonies that found the underworld.
d:Silverline.SL_BankDef/SL_CompoundInter: Low fees and gentle loans, paid for by a small account fee.
Home of the faith funds (once investments and indulgences are researched).
d:Silverline.SL_BankDef/SL_ImperialTreas: Loans only if somebody in the colony holds a royal title; very cheap interest.
Slightly lower account yield (-10 % in the exponent).
Neutral and fair: no tricks, no surprises.
d:Silverline.SL_BankDef/SL_OrbitalExchan: Best market access once investments are researched.
Highest fees: 0.5 % to deposit, 2 % to withdraw (minimum 10), account fee 10 silver per quadrum.
Best account yield of the mainstream banks (+10 % in the exponent).
Bailout: once per game year, a customer who was a Too Big To Fail ten minutes ago and is now in the red gets an interest-free 60 day loan (up to 10 % of the peak).
d:Silverline.SL_ClaimFormDef/SL_ClaimFor: A colonist who can confirm it.
How it came about. Cosmetic, like most of the form.
Clawback Mutual files it, reads it, and then decides as always.
Minor, major or total. The assessor will not look.
A colonist who saw it. Their statement is filed with the form.
Silver by the usual route, or the building materials by drop capsule (only Good Enough and Premium). This is the one field that counts.
How would you like to be paid?
d:Silverline.SL_ClauseDef/SL_Clause_1.te: Cover begins after the waiting period, which begins after cover begins.
d:Silverline.SL_ClauseDef/SL_Clause_11.t: Self-inflicted damage includes damage by you, your colonists, your animals, your turrets and anyone standing near them.
Walls must be walls. A wall with a door in it is a door.
d:Silverline.SL_ClauseDef/SL_Clause_17.t: Clause 17 is attached separately, in Thrumbo.
d:Silverline.SL_ClauseDef/SL_Clause_21.t: Bionic parts are equipment and are insured under Muffalo & Machine Cover, which you do not have.
d:Silverline.SL_ClauseDef/SL_Clause_22.t: If a lost part grows back, so does our claim.
d:Silverline.SL_ClauseDef/SL_Clause_23.t: Dying before the assessment ends the assessment.
d:Silverline.SL_ClauseDef/SL_Clause_26.t: Changes in risk must be reported within one day. This includes swords.
d:Silverline.SL_ClauseDef/SL_Clause_30.t: Cancellations require Form C-7, signed in triplicate, in an ink colour we have on file.
d:Silverline.SL_ClauseDef/SL_Clause_31.t: Your policy renews automatically to spare you the burden of deciding.
An accident is a sudden external event. Thrumbos are external. Your cooking is not.
d:Silverline.SL_ClauseDef/SL_Clause_4.te: Acts of Storyteller are excluded unless the Storyteller acted reasonably.
d:Silverline.SL_ClauseDef/SL_Clause_40.t: Legal Shield does not cover disputes with Clawback Mutual, for reasons we are not required to explain.
d:Silverline.SL_ClauseDef/SL_Clause_7b.t: Raids are not war. Sieges are war. Mechanoid clusters are weather.
d:Silverline.SL_ClauseDef/SL_Clause_9.te: Pre-existing conditions include conditions that existed before, during or shortly after this policy.
d:Silverline.SL_PolicyDef/SL_ActsOfStory: Cash for the destroyed building, after your own share.
Cash, or the building materials delivered by capsule.
Replacement value, paid instantly by capsule. Goodwill once a year.
Buildings of your colony that are destroyed by enemy hands (raids, sieges, mechanoids). Not fire, not storms, not your own turrets.
Pays 10 % more of every loss (never more than the loss itself).
The claims department looks at your claim one day sooner.
d:Silverline.SL_PolicyDef/SL_BlightBeGon: Cash for the lost harvest, after your own share.
Full value of the harvest, instantly.
Your crops in a cold snap or toxic fallout.
Pays 10 % more of every loss (never more than the loss itself).
d:Silverline.SL_PolicyDef/SL_ClosedForRe: A flat day, whatever the day was worth.
The average daily loss, up to five days.
Daily loss for up to 15 days.
Lost income after a closure of your venue, reported by the businesses of Hearth & Harbor.
d:Silverline.SL_PolicyDef/SL_GoldenYears: The sum insured, once, when the colonist turns 60.
0.4 % of the sum insured per day, from 60.
0.6 % of the sum insured per day, from 60. A retirement party is thinkable.

One colonist who is not yet 60. From the age of 60 Clawback Mutual pays a daily pension (Bare Minimum: a single lump sum). The premium rises the closer the colonist is to 60; nobody can buy a pension at 60 or later.
d:Silverline.SL_PolicyDef/SL_ItWasntMe.b: Half of the compensation, paid to the injured party's faction.
80 % of the compensation. Goodwill loss halved.
All of it. The rumour is also taken care of.
d:Silverline.SL_PolicyDef/SL_ItWasntMe.c: Damage to guests and to traders' goods for which your colony is liable. Reported by the inn, the market and the trade desk.
d:Silverline.SL_PolicyDef/SL_ItWasntMe.r: The claims department looks at your claim one day sooner.
